authorization.scope: All three third-review findings, scope preflight, native streaming settlement, regressions, manual example mode, AMOS and documentation. No API break or later-stage work.

findings.change: Validate first-party nested thinking replay before discovery/counting/reduction/archive. Preserve supported matching-provider representations, custom native adapters and ordinary non-native converters.
findings.evidence: Both mismatch directions; missing/empty/foreign replay fields; direct count/compact and managed prefix/recent/pending run/stream/manual; zero HTTP/archive/model attempts; actual SDK matching-provider controls and custom-adapter control.

findings.change: Share the existing bounded compaction lifecycle for manual targets, retaining manual trigger, single preservation callback, existing events/error behavior and bounded refresh. Scope preflight precedes hooks/counting.
findings.evidence: All/history/plugins targets with automatic disabled; notes/whiteboard; contribution revision/timeout/cancellation; protected boundary/scope rejection; no-op/hook error; settlement lease; checkpoint save retry without replay; AMOS command checkpoints the preserved note; real OpenAI/Anthropic manual continuation.

findings.change: Resolve native fixed-thinking budget through the existing Anthropic converter. Select budget plus 4096 summary tokens by default, bounded by model output ceiling, or respect explicit host/request cap. Use the same output for source headroom, actual native wire and ModelTask reservation; reject conflicts before archival. Internal streaming supports large caps.
findings.evidence: Below/at/above old cap; default/large fixed budgets; adaptive/disabled controls; explicit caps and early conflict rejection; source capacity and wire/reservation agreement; managed run/stream/manual; failed/truncated usage and stream cancellation; real Sonnet 4.6 compacts and continues with fixed 8192 thinking.

compatibility.notes: Internal replay/lifecycle/native output/transport corrections; algorithmic and existing non-native defaults remain unchanged. Existing context strategy/plugin/storage signatures, public return/event shapes and optional native envelope remain unchanged.

resolvedValidationIncidents.details: All initial 53 new regression cases failed on the pre-fix runtime. Final provider/core coverage adds matching-provider/custom controls, cap/transport/usage/preflight cases and manual checkpoint/refresh checks.

Pending input tests now preserve the actual pending packet with the array-input API instead of replacing it with a new string; plugin-count fixtures reflect real reduction rather than forcing constant counts. Strict tool schemas and save mock return types are explicit.
A 63000-token fixed-budget control exposed the SDK nonstreaming limit. The adapter now uses internal streaming; all large-cap, usage and cancellation checks pass.

The shared manual lifecycle preflights evidence ownership before counting or hooks. After this native-only refinement, the final build, full local/unit/offline gates and all 11 affected real native cases were rerun. The 201-case matrix remains separate, with the affected native subset revalidated on final source.
